## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]

The report rates GPSO Neutral/Wait with low-to-moderate confidence. Its IDR 252 close is near the derived IDR 250 20/60-day low; RSI 29.6334, stochastic and channel oversold readings support a possible mean-reversion bounce. Bearish Aroon, SuperTrend, MACD, Fisher, EMA positioning and negative multi-horizon momentum oppose a confirmed reversal. Volume Ratio 20D is only 0.1057. Rising MFI conflicts with declining OBV/ADL, negative CMF and weak PVO.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]

For the session-5 close, the report assigns bull IDR 280–290 at 25%, base IDR 250–266 at 45%, and bear IDR 236–248 at 30%. Its representative gross expected return is +3.15%, with weighted endpoints +0.52% to +5.79%. These subjective probabilities are not calibrated and exclude execution costs, taxes, dividends, gaps and adjustments.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]

Its dated news narrative describes Tjokro Group business transformation, June shareholder approvals, July placement and possible later consolidation/rights issuance. The September 24 promotional story is explicitly single-source commentary without a confirmed new contract. No company event is confirmed inside the five-session window. The report describes BI/rupiah and global-rate/oil pressure as counterweights to the corporate narrative.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]

The report calls for a completed close above IDR 258 with improved participation before considering entry. A close below IDR 250 invalidates the thesis; exact entry and executable stop are unavailable. Conditional profit zones are IDR 266–280 and 280–290. Its IDR 260/250/280 illustration yields 2.0 gross reward-to-risk but is expressly not an executable recommendation.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, with financing/imported-equipment sensitivity unquantified. Its September global-news coverage describes Fed tightening and dollar/yield pressure as a bearish overlay for smaller emerging-market equities.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]
